meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

copy.tagline: 禁止 AI 代理绕过 Git 提交检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude Code 项目中强制提交质量检查。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from skipping pre-commit checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce commit quality gates in Claude Code projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次要跑 Bash 命令都会先被检查；如果 git 命令里带了 --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign，这次调用会被直接拒绝并给出提示，其他命令照常执行。
howto.when: 在配置了该 hook 的项目里，每次 Bash 工具调用都会被检查；git 命令中带 --no-verify 等绕过标志时即被拦截。

say.text: 帮我在这个项目里加上禁止 --no-verify 的 hook
把这个 hook 装到全局，所有项目都生效
验证一下 hook 能不能拦住 git commit --no-verify
say.note: 该命令会被 BLOCKED 并退出码 2

howto.what_en: Once installed, every Bash call Claude makes is inspected first. A git command containing --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign is rejected outright with a message; other commands run as usual.
howto.when_en: In a project configured with this hook, each Bash tool call is inspected; git commands carrying a bypass flag such as --no-verify are blocked.

say_en.text: Add a hook to this project that blocks --no-verify
Install the hook globally so every project uses it
Verify the hook blocks git commit --no-verify
say_en.note: That command is blocked with exit code 2
